zh-CN.title: 礼与秩序
zh-CN.subtitle: 经典、仪式与制度化身份
zh-CN.shortSummary: “礼”既可以指文本和规范，也可以指具体仪式、身份关系与国家教育制度中的秩序实践。
curatorialDescription: 《论语》段落提供了文本入口；唐代经学制度则显示经典解释如何进入教育和国家秩序。
本概念不把儒家等同于单一政治意识形态，而是保留文本、仪式和制度之间的张力。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充《五经正义》不同版本、经学制度和具体仪式语境的逐条出处。

en.title: Ritual and order
en.subtitle: Classics, ritual and institutional identity
en.shortSummary: Li can refer to texts and norms as well as concrete ritual, relational identity and order within state education.
curatorialDescription: A passage from the Analects provides a textual entry point, while Tang classical learning shows how interpretation entered education and state order.
The concept does not reduce Confucianism to one political ideology; it keeps tensions among text, ritual and institution visible.
en.researchNote: Different editions of the Corrected Meanings, classical-learning institutions and specific ritual contexts still need item-level citations.
